instrument: tools/g17capturerepeat.py (the retained authored A/B control through Metal, Frida attached passively), compared with tools/g17capturediff.py against evidence/g17-belowmetal-preflight/authored-pair-metal/passive-submit-with-requests.json (macOS 26.6.2, 25G83)
gpu_dispatched: through Metal only; nothing submitted below Metal
conclusion: Metal's own Submit for the same control differs between the two OS builds beyond run-to-run variation in 25 of 44 captured structures: the 64-byte Submit record, 19 of 29 selector-9 allocation requests, the kernel command buffer and segment list, the launch packet window and the driver's code region. The below-Metal runtime writes these structures as recorded on 25G83, so its layouts are not shown to hold on 26A434, and it was not dispatched there. Whether each difference is a format change or a per-boot value is not separated here.
